# Daily Dashboard V0.5.0

A complete interface refresh with consistent dark surfaces, compact controls, clearer typography, and layouts that respond to each widget’s available space.

## What changed

- Settings now has nine sections with fixed navigation and save controls, keyboard focus management, and clear save feedback.
- Calendar meetings share columns when they overlap. Event details open in a bounded panel with readable metadata and keyboard dismissal.
- Music controls stay in normal layout flow, weather scrolls within compact widgets, and hidden navigation no longer intercepts calendar controls.
- Clock layouts, timezone menus, maps, terminal and ambient backgrounds share the updated interface conventions.
- Application scaling now includes 175%, alongside 75%, 100%, 125%, 150% and 200%.
- The empty dashboard includes a direct action to reveal widget controls.

## Install over an earlier version

Download the Windows setup `.exe` attached below and run it on the machine where Daily Dashboard is already installed. Close the running dashboard first when installing manually. This release retains the same application identifier, product name and current-user installation mode so existing settings remain available.

For the in-app update path, open **Settings → Updates** in V0.5.0 (or the application-update controls in older versions) and check for updates. This repository is private, so older installations need a GitHub token with repository read access to discover or download the release.

## Validation

- Production frontend build and unit/static checks passed.
- Browser UI regressions passed for calendar search and details, settings, clocks, weather, idle backgrounds, map gestures, terminal and aircraft layouts.
- The display matrix covers 1280×480 at 100%, intermediate 1920×600 sizes, 2560×800 at 100–200% application scaling, and simulated 125–200% OS scaling.
- Native Windows installer construction is verified by this release’s GitHub Actions build. An upgrade on a physical Windows machine remains to be tested.
